headline: Got a community? Members find each other.
subtitle: A private member directory, events with RSVPs, and an 'ask for intro' button on every profile. Set it up once — the community runs itself.

subtitles.askIntro: Members request warm intros from each other.

descriptions.directory: A searchable, member-facing directory — roles, tags, and bios in one place. Members find each other without going through you.
descriptions.events: Create events with RSVPs and automatic reminders. See who's attending before the doors open.
descriptions.askIntro: Members request warm intros from each other — instead of cold outreach, members leverage shared trust to open doors that would otherwise remain closed.
descriptions.adminControls: Approve new members, assign roles, and moderate the directory from a single organizer dashboard.
